That includes the round-2 repairs T-DG4-ARCH-R5, T-DG4-KBE-R6 and T-DG4-FE-R5, the orchestrator's 546fb4e, and the D-121 merge edits. I formed this verdict from my own runs in a complete (non-shallow) disposable clone of c94b2a2 (source 925f0bc) under $TMPDIR, on disposable PostgreSQL clusters. I did not open any other reviewer's round-3 record or evidence.

checks_run.expected: No weakened behaviour; the rule fits the source.
checks_run.actual: The headline rule fits M0172 and B0145, and is accepted. The re-baselined tests, including QA's a04-a05-a10-partials and a04-kpi-propagation, move fixtures to the right basis or select the top-line headline; no assertion is dropped. valueStatusOf (closure, status separation) is untouched and reads all benefits. Three defects: (1) formatValue's new percent branch does not scale fractions (F-DG4-125, High). (2) ADR-0037 N3 item 2 removes revenue uplift and avoided cost from the Value RAG, which turns a 300-of-370 unvalidated world from Red (at 93a7dd7, derived from the five-class sum, not executed) to Green: a regression against B0095/M0248 (F-DG4-126, Medium). (3) KBE-R6 §5.3 (d): the Portfolio item value stays a five-class SAR sum (435) with no basis (F-DG4-127, Medium). Accepted: §5.3 (a) gross as a known zero beside an n/a headline (it keeps net = -cost visible; the ADR's 'same figure in any state and currency' wording is loose there, noted, not a finding), (b), (c), (e). checks_run.procedure: Re-check the operating rules outside the repair diff against the playbook and master prompt (the code is unchanged since round 2, which I verify with git diff): escalation once to the next authority; the blocker rule; quorum and immutable minutes; corrective-case dedup; the closure guard; BAU acceptance; G5/G6; exceptions and waivers; the Modular G3 waiver (D-110, ADR-0021 W1-W7); change requests; traceability. The green acceptance suites (DOM-R3-03) execute these. Judge QA-C O-2 and QA-B 409/422, and the register's partial disclosures.
checks_run.command: git diff --stat 93a7dd7..925f0bc -- apps/api/src/modules (only reporting/ changed); integration run as DOM-R3-03
checks_run.expected: Rules match their sources; the observations and partial disclosures are acceptable.
checks_run.actual: Outside reporting/ no API module changed in the repair, and the A03-A14 acceptance and backend suites pass 1960/1960. My round-2 conclusions therefore hold. RAG comes from the KPI trajectory, never completion. Forecast, submitted and scenario values never count as validated. Finance validation is FIN-only, with the correction chain kept. Escalation is once, to the next authority. Closure is refused while value is pending unless a transition decision exists. BAU acceptance is by the receiver only, and the recurring reviews are created once. G5 requires risk closure and the scale scope, and scaling outside it is refused. G6 requires ownership transfer. Exceptions and waivers carry an expiry and a compensating action. The Modular waiver covers missing links only and is refused when revoked or expired. A change request keeps its originals. Allocations over 100 % are refused, and over 110 % on links. QA-C O-2: the record stays 'draft' until explicit activation while G1-G6 progress. The playbook defines phases and gates, not a record lifecycle, so this is acceptable. QA-B: 409 gate.submission_superseded on a Draft gate is DG2-approved contract behaviour, and REQ-S04-010 requires only rejection; accepted as an observation. The register's partial disclosures (PB-065, PB-066, PB-075, S04-010, S04-014, S07-005, S07-007, S07-015, S08-006, S08-015, S13-003, S15-008, S20-011) are honest and acceptable. The register was not changed by the repair.

summary: FAIL. All three round-2 findings are CLOSED_VERIFIED. F-DG4-122: the gap renders as 100 %, 25 %, -20 % and 12.5 % in EN and AR, never as money. F-DG4-123: 90/300/45 on four surfaces, labelled, 435 nowhere, drill-downs sum, the revenue-only world n/a. F-DG4-124: the validators and history are legal. The headline basis (D-119) is accepted against M0172 and B0145. New: F-DG4-125 (High, mandatory): the FE-R5 formatter shows a 12 % KPI (stored as 0.12) as '0.12 %' on the dashboards. F-DG4-126 (Medium): the Value RAG now ignores the revenue-uplift and avoided-cost gaps, giving a false Green (a partial rejection of D-119 item 1, the RAG scope only). F-DG4-127 (Medium): the Portfolio initiative value is still a five-class SAR sum (435). The candidate suites pass (integration 1960/1960, unit on Node 22 and 24), and the real-stack probes pass 49/49, 38/38 and 127/127.
